description: Ethereum MEV-Boost delivered blocks from the Flashbots relay: proposer payment in ETH (block value), transaction count, gas used vs limit, and builder pubkeys with block counts. Covers the newest blocks only (1 to 50). Sandwich volume is not in this source and is not reported. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many of the newest delivered blocks, 1 to 50 (default 10)
